s: Many Jersey City streets are zone-permit streets: without a resident zone permit you can park at most 2 hours where signs say so.
quote: Resident parking permits are required for parking for more than 2 hours in many areas.

s: To get or renew a zone permit the driver's licence must show the Jersey City home address and the registration must be valid; renewals are reviewed by hand each time. The page states no fee and no building-size exclusion.
quote: Driver's License: Must be valid and reflect your current residential address.

s: Permit price and whether tenants of large apartment buildings are eligible: not stated on the city Parking page. The permit portal jcparking.cmrpay.com refused (HTTP 403 at robots.txt, stopped); the city's '2022 Parking Permits New Ordinance' PDF is a scanned image with no text; the open-data page 'Multi Unit Residential Parking Permits' (data.jerseycitynj.gov) renders by script and its /api/ is disallowed by robots.txt. The code (Ch. 332) is on a blocked code host.
Street-cleaning no-parking times are set block by block on posted signs. When the city suspends parking regulations, street cleaning, zone-permit and meter rules are not enforced that day.
quote: Posted signs will indicate a need for a parking permit, parking restrictions for street cleaning, and other limitations for street parking.

s: In a snow emergency all cars must be moved off the designated snow emergency routes (city ordinance 332-34); violators are ticketed and towed.
quote: Remove all vehicles from designated snow EMERGENCY ROUTES to facilitate plowing/salting operations.

s: No citywide overnight on-street parking ban is stated on the city's Parking, Snow Information or Advisories pages; restrictions are by posted sign and zone. Ordinance text not read (blocked code host).
Every dog 6 months or older needs a Jersey City licence and must wear the tag in public; licence at the shelter or online.
quote: NJ law requires a license for all dogs 6 months or older. Dogs must wear their license tag when in public.

s: 2026 fees: 1 year $10 neutered / $20 unneutered; 3 years $25 / $50; $5 late fee after June 30. Rabies vaccination proof required.
quote: Neutered dogs: $10.00 per dog Unneutered dogs: $20.00 per dog

s: The city pages read (Animal Care & Control, Dog Licenses, Park Maintenance, alphabetical parks list PDF) name no dog runs, though the dog licence page shows photos of the Van Vorst Park dog run and says licence data informs 'dog runs and parks'. No dog-run permit requirement was stated.
Leash rule and any limit on number of dogs are not stated on the city pages read; ordinance text is on a blocked code host.

Statewide: dogs 7 months or older must be licensed every year through the town where the owner lives, with proof of rabies vaccination. Town fees run $1.50 to $21 per dog, plus $1 state fee and $3 more if not spayed/neutered.
quote: Dogs seven months of age or older must be licensed annually through the municipality where the owner lives.

s: Statewide: every dog over six months must be licensed with the town clerk by June 30 each year; $8 neutered/spayed, $19 unaltered; $1 per month late fee; current rabies vaccination required. (State application form dated 2015; fee confirmed on town pages where read.)
quote: All dogs over six months must be licensed. All dogs must be licensed by the 30th of June of each year.

s: Bayonne has citywide residential permit parking on weekdays (no permit needed on weekends). A resident's virtual permit costs $5, one per car, valid in every residential area of the city; needs driver's licence, registration and a proof of residency from the last 3 months (utility, phone, credit-card bill, pay stub...).
quote: Residents of the City of Bayonne may apply for a virtual parking permit, and park on the streets of Bayonne. You do not need a parking permit on the weekends.

s: IMPORTANT for new apartment buildings: anyone living in a development inside a Redevelopment Area whose plan was adopted on or after Jan 15, 2015 cannot get a residential street-parking permit (Ordinance 7-17.8). Ask each building whether it is in such a redevelopment area.
quote: Any and all occupants residing within Developments located within a Redevelopment Area wherein a Redevelopment Plan was adopted by the city on or after January 15, 2015, are hereby excluded by the City from obtaining any Residential Parking Permits

s: Fees from January 2023 news release: resident permit $5; visitor permit $5 per 21 days; non-resident permit $200 a year.
quote: Residential parking permits will cost five dollars each.

s: Parking Utility lots: monthly permit $150 (daily permit) or $70 a month for a night lot permit, in some lots only; virtual permits.
quote: from thirty-five dollars per month to seventy dollars per month for night lot permits

s: Street sweeping runs on a published weekday schedule by avenue and side (start times 7 AM to 11 AM); cars must be moved for it.
quote: Please take note of the Street Sweeping schedule so you can move your cars accordingly.

s: No overnight on-street ban stated on the Parking Utility page, the 2023 fee release or ordinance O-22-41; snow rules not found. Most of the city site is script-rendered (no sitemap); only pages found by search were read.

Dog licence fee, leash rule, dog limit and dog parks not found: the Health / animal-control pages returned an error page or an empty script shell; the City Clerk page lists no dog licence. State rule applies (licence at 7 months, see New Jersey statewide row).

Every car parked on an East Orange street overnight (2-6 AM, every day) must have an overnight parking permit, and only on streets signed 'Permit Required to Park'. Streets signed 'NO PARKING 2AM-6AM ANY DAY' allow no overnight parking even with a permit (ticket and tow).
quote: The City of East Orange requires all cars that are parked on the street overnight to purchase and display a parking permit.

s: Parking Authority wording: a permit is needed 2-6 AM, every day, on all streets that allow overnight parking; residents only.
quote: The City of East Orange requires a parking permit for all streets everyday of the week that allow overnight parking between the hours of 2a.m. to 6a.m.

s: Overnight street permit: $150 per car per calendar year, pro-rated by month of purchase ($25 if bought in November, $12.50 in December), plus $7.50 transaction fee; $75 senior/disabled. Sold online by the East Orange Parking Authority.
quote: The Overnight Parking Permit Fee is $150 per car for the period of January 1st to December 31st, all permits expire on December 31st.

s: Renters qualify: documents are driver's licence, registration, insurance and proof of residency; if those do not show the East Orange address, a valid lease (or utility/bank statement within 90 days) is accepted. No apartment-building exclusion is stated. An out-of-state licence/registration is therefore usable with a lease, per this page.
quote: If the above mandatory documents do not have your East Orange address you must also upload the following documents as proof of residency: a.Valid Lease Agreement

s: Visitor overnight hang tag: $6 per night, from City Hall licensing / online.
quote: Resident Parking permits can be purchased for $150. Parking hang tag for $6 per night.

s: Parking Authority lot permits: $55 a month overnight only (8 PM-8 AM) or $80 a month all day, first come first served, valid only in the chosen lot.
quote: Overnight permits between 8pm to 8am are $55 per month or $80 per month for all day parking.

s: Alternate-side rules apply and must be obeyed even with an overnight permit (the packet says '2am-6pm').
quote: Alternative side parking rules for 2am-6pm must be followed to avoid getting a ticket.

s: In snow emergencies the emergency no-parking rules and posted NO PARKING signs apply and overnight rules are strictly enforced.
quote: During snow emergencies, all emergency parking rules are in effect. Motorists should adhere to all NO PARKING signs on county and city roads.

s: Dog licences are issued at 143 New Street (Health Dept, 973-266-5450) per the 2026 Welcome Packet; fee, leash rule, dog limit and dog parks not stated in the packet or the pages read. State rule applies (see New Jersey statewide row).

Bloomfield has an overnight permit parking ordinance (187-16) and a 'permit parking only' ordinance (393-11); the court's penalty schedule lists a $30 and a $50 fine. The hours, permit price and eligibility were not on pages we may read (the township FAQ pages are disallowed to Claude agents by robots.txt; a search result says permits are issued by the Police Department - unverified).
quote: 187-16 Overnight Permit Parking $30

s: Snow-emergency no-parking streets exist (list published by Public Works); fine $125.
quote: 254-27 Snow Emergency - No Parking $125

s: The Health Department 'Animal Licensing' page carries only a link to a PDF form (not opened); fee, leash rule, dog limit and dog parks not found on the pages read. State rule applies.
Dog licence: $15 altered, $18 non-altered, within 10 days of getting a dog of licensing age (7 months); late fee $10 from March 1 plus $5 each further month.
quote: $18.00 - Non-Altered Dog $15.00 - Altered Dog

s: All dogs must be on a leash whenever off the owner's property.
quote: There is a leash law in Parsippany that requires all dogs, when off property, to be contained by a leash.

s: Cameron Dog Park is a public dog park that needs a permit, issued by the Animal Control Division (fee not stated; 973-263-7083 per search result, unverified).
quote: The Animal Control Division issues permits for the Cameron Dog Park.

s: No overnight or winter on-street parking rule found on the township home page, forms page or Animal Control page; a domain search surfaced only council minutes amending 'parking prohibited during certain hours on certain streets' (Ch. 405-15), not read. The home page lists a 'Parking Permits' service (script menu, not reachable).
Dog licence from the City/Town Clerk, 54 Hill Street, starting June 1 each year: $8 spayed/neutered, $19 if not; online renewal available.
quote: $8.00 SPAYED/NEUTERED $19.00 IF NOT

s: Shelton Animal Control enforces a leash law for dogs (the page does not give the leash length or wording).
quote: enforce laws pertaining to animals such as the leash law for dogs and vaccination requirements for dogs and cats

s: No winter / overnight on-street parking rule on the Police, Public Works, Highways & Bridges pages (snow plowing is described; parking is not). A domain search surfaced only meeting minutes mentioning a 'Winter Parking Restrictions' section of Chapter 16 (not read). No dog park found. www.cityofshelton.org fails TLS; the bare host works.

During a declared snow parking ban, no parking on the odd-numbered side of all Hamden streets; cars may be towed and fined up to $50. Residents are asked to keep cars off the street during and right after storms.
quote: Parking bans prohibit parking on the odd-numbered side of all Hamden streets

s: All dogs 6 months and older licensed yearly (July 1-June 30; renew in June) at the Town Clerk; a new dog must be licensed within 30 days. Fee is the state fee (see Connecticut statewide row); online renewals add $3.50 + $0.59.
quote: Connecticut law requires all dogs 6 months and older to be licensed annually. Licenses are valid July 1 through June 30th.

s: Owner must pick up dog waste at once on sidewalks, streets, parks and other public property.
quote: unless such person shall remove all feces so deposited by such animal immediately before leaving the area of the defecation

s: Connecticut statute (CGS 22-364(a), as summarised by the Town of Hamden): a dog may not roam at large on another's land or on public highways when not under the owner's control; ticketable infraction. This is a control rule, not a leash-length rule; towns may add leash ordinances.
quote: This statute also prohibits dog roaming on public highways.

s: No overnight ban or resident permit found on hamden.com pages read (sitemap pages matching parking / snow / dog words); only the storm-time odd-side ban. No dog park page found.
Dog licence at the Town Clerk, 10 Maple Avenue (online or mail): $8 neutered/spayed, $19 not; renew June 1-30; $1 per month late (new dogs exempt); rabies certificate required.
quote: Fees Neutered/Spayed Dogs $8 Non Neutered/Spayed Dogs $19

s: No parking, winter-ban or dog-park page found among the 8 pages read on beaconfalls-ct.org (home, sitemap pages matching parking / snow / dog words: Animal Control, dog licence pages).

During a declared parking ban, no parking on the even-numbered side of every road (unless the odd side is posted No Parking), and none on either side of the listed snow emergency routes (Campbell Ave, Savin Ave, Elm St, Main St and others). $100 fine and tow. School, beach and municipal lots are open for off-street parking during the ban.
quote: parking is prohibited on the even-numbered side of a road during a declared parking ban, unless the road is posted with a "No Parking" sign on the odd side

s: No year-round overnight ban or resident street permit found on the 9 cityofwesthaven.com pages read (only event/guest parking permits from Human Resources and the storm parking ban). Dog licence fee, leash rule and dog park not on the pages read (Animal Shelter page); state licence rule applies.

Resident permit parking on designated streets: $10 a year per registered vehicle, expires Dec 31; needs driver's licence, registration and insurance ALL showing the current Bound Brook address (so an out-of-state registration at an old address would not qualify). No building-size exclusion stated.
quote: The annual fee is $10.00 per registered vehicle for residents of streets or portions thereof where residential parking restrictions apply.

s: Visitor permits per dwelling unit through the portal: $5 a day Mon-Thu, $10 a day Fri-Sun, not beyond seven consecutive days.
quote: Monday through Thursday: $5 per day Friday through Sunday: $10 per day

s: The borough runs seasonal street sweeping on a published schedule (ended for the 2026 season).
quote: Street sweeping has concluded for the 2026 season!

s: Only some residential streets have permit-only parking; permits go to residents whose address is on such a street (Traffic Safety Section, application with each vehicle's registration). Fee not stated on the page. Elsewhere no permit scheme.
quote: Some residential streets in the Township of East Brunswick have restricted parking for residents and their visitors.

s: Public dog park at Heavenly Farms Park, Dunhams Corner Road (township facility page lists 'Heavenly Farms - Dog Park'); permit requirement not stated on the pages read.
quote: There is also a public bulletin board at the dog park located at Heavenly Farms Park on Dunhams Corner Road.

s: NO overnight parking 2-6 AM on any street or in any lot in South Orange without a permit or temporary permission from the Parking Authority (SOPA) or police (ordinance 152-11.1).
quote: There is no overnight parking (2am to 6am) anywhere in South Orange without temporary permission from the Parking Authority or Police Department or a valid parking permit.

s: Apartment-building residents do NOT get an on-street permit: with no off-street parking they qualify only for municipal LOT permits (Library, Scotland Rd, South Orange Ave, Riverside, Irvington Ave lots). The night permit covers 2-8 AM; lots are free 6 PM-2 AM.
quote: Do you live in an apartment building with no off-street or available parking or a multifamily house with a driveway that you can't use? You would qualify for the municipal lot parking permits

s: On-street permits (free, day and night) are only for one- or two-family homes with no driveway, within one block of the home.
quote: Do you live in a one or two family home with no driveway? You would qualify for an On-Street permit to park in front of your residence or within a one block radius.

s: Resident lot permit fees: night $25 a month / $45 quarter / $100 half-year / $150 a year; day $40 a month / $375 a year. On-street permit: no fee.
quote: Resident Night: Monthly - $25 Quarterly - $45 Semi-Annual - $100 Annual - $150

s: Visitors' overnight parking: call SOPA (or police after hours); $5 per night.
quote: There is a $5.00 fee per night for overnight parking for visitors/guest.

s: On-street permits are subject to Emergency Snow Removal regulations (cars must move when declared).
quote: All on-street permits are subject to Emergency Snow Removal regulations.

s: Dog licence yearly (due January; pets 6 months or older): $17 spayed/neutered, $20 not; $20 late fee on renewals after March 1.
quote: License for spayed / neutered $17.00 License for not spayed / neutered $20.00

s: Animal Control guidance: leash under 6 feet and dog under control whenever off your property; always pick up.
quote: Use a leash under 6 feet and have your dog under control when not on your property.

s: Whenever snow covers the street, no vehicle may park on any borough street 11 PM-7 AM until streets are plowed (code 680-3J); municipal lots are free for overnight parking while the ban lasts.
quote: no vehicle may be parked on Borough streets between 11:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m.

s: Residential parking permit from the Parking Utility, 42 West Front Street: driver's licence and valid registration required; no expiry / renewal. Fee and building eligibility not stated.
quote: Residents may apply to the office of the Borough Parking Utility located at 42 West Front Street for a residential parking permit. Driver License and a valid vehicle registration card are required.

s: Parking is free throughout town after 9 PM on weekdays and all day Sunday.
quote: Parking throughout town is free after 9 p.m. on weekdays and all day Sunday.

s: Alternate-side parking restrictions are enforced all year, whatever the weather and whether or not the sweeper runs (days/hours on signs).
quote: Alternate Side Parking is enforced all year round, regardless of weather conditions

s: The borough has a Resident Parking Program (ordinance 285-25 lists streets and times) with resident, extended-temporary, overnight and daytime permit applications; fees and eligibility are in PDFs / the ordinance, not on the page.
quote: the Borough of East Rutherford has established a Resident Parking Program

s: All dogs licensed each January (expires Dec 31): $10 spayed/neutered, $13 not; $25 late fee from Feb 15; rabies vaccination valid through November.
quote: $10 for each spayed/neutered dog $13 for each non-spayed / non-neutered dog

s: Resident-only street parking applies only in a few beach-area zones (e.g. Seaview, Marine & Ocean Terrace, Arthur Avenue), seasonally May 1-Sept 30; permit needs licence and registration at that address. No citywide permit scheme stated.
quote: Your neighborhood has been designated as a "Residential Parking Area Only" on a yearly, seasonal basis. The season begins on May 1st and ends on September 30th.

s: Dog licence: $12 spayed/neutered, $18 not; proof of rabies vaccination.
quote: $12 for spayed or neutered dogs. $18 for non-spayed or non-neutered dogs.

s: Dogs must be leashed on all public thoroughfares; owner disposes of waste.
quote: All dogs must be leashed when being walked on public thoroughfares.

s: Dogs banned from all beaches May 1-Sept 30 and never allowed on the boardwalk/promenade; leashed dogs allowed on public beaches (Seaview to Brighton Ave) Oct 1-Apr 30.
quote: Dogs are prohibited on all beaches from May 1 through September 30.
